legend: Recently Manya learned that a permutation is a sequence of $$$n$$$ distinct integers from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ in arbitrary order. For example, $$$2,3,1,5,4$$$ is a permutation, but $$$1,2,2$$$ is not a permutation ($$$2$$$ appears twice) and $$$1,3,4$$$ is also not a permutation ($$$n=3$$$ but there is $$$4$$$ in the sequence).

Manya started to write down random permutations, one under another. She wrote down $$$n-1$$$ permutations and realized that a column in the resulting table of integers can also turn out to be a permutation when Manya writes down the $$$n$$$th permutation. Every column will consist of $$$n$$$ integers from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, however, not every column will be a valid permutation. Then Many decided to add the $$$n$$$th permutation in a way to maximize the number of columns-permutations.

Your task is to find out the maximum number of columns that could be permutations after adding the $$$n$$$th permutation; and how many permutations will result in the highest number of columns-permutations.
input: The first line contains a single integer $$$n$$$ — the permutation length ($$$2 \le n \le 1000$$$).
Each of the next $$$n-1$$$ lines contains a permutation of length $$$n$$$ — $$$n$$$ integers from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$.
output: Output two integers — the maximum number of column-permutations that can be achieved after adding a permutation; and the number of permutations that can be added to achieve the highest number of columns-permutations modulo $$$10^9 + 7$$$.
note: In the first example, the first column needs $$$2$$$ to be a permutation as well as the fourth column, the third column needs $$$1$$$. Manya can add permutations:
to get two columns-permutations. It is not possible to get a result with three columns-permutations as the $$$n$$$th permutation can not contain two $$$2$$$.

In the second example, none of the columns will be a valid permutation, no matter what permutation Manya adds. That means that the maximum number of columns-permutations is $$$0$$$ and can be achieved by adding any of the $$$24$$$ permutations.

legend: 玛尼娅开始写下随机排列，一个接一个。她写下了$$$n-1$$$个排列，并意识到当Manya写下$$$n$$$个排列时，生成的整数表中的一列也可能是一个排列。每一列都由从$$$1$$$到$$$n$$$的整数$$$n$$$组成，但是，并不是每一列都是有效的排列。然后Many决定以最大化列排列数量的方式添加第$$$n$$$个排列。
你的任务是找出添加第$$$n$$$个排列后可能是排列的最大列数；多少个排列会产生最多的列-排列。
input: 第一行包含一个整数$$$n$$$--排列长度($$$2 \le n \le 1000$$$）。
接下来的每一行 $$$n-1$$$ 都包含长度 $$$n$$$——从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的 $$$n$$$ 整数的排列。
output: 输出两个整数—添加一个排列后可以实现的最大列排列数；以及为达到最大列数可添加的排列数-排列模$$$10^9 + 7$$$。
note: 在第一个例子中，第一列需要 $$$2$$$ 和第四列一样是一个排列，第三列需要 $$$1$$$。玛尼亚可以添加排列组合：
得到两列排列。不可能得到三列排列的结果，因为第 $$$n$$$ 次排列不能包含两个 $$$2$$$。
在第二个示例中，无论Manya添加什么排列，所有列都不是有效的排列。这意味着列排列的最大数量是$$$0$$$，可以通过添加任何$$$24$$$排列来实现。
